Geographies Served Programs Youth Fellowship Programme District New Delhi Mumbai Suburban State Delhi Maharashtra District New Delhi Mumbai Suburban States Delhi Maharashtra The Youth Fellowship Programme by Praja Foundation aims to empower youth to understand urban governance and the roles of elected representatives through fieldwork and research. Participants gain insights into civic issues and engage in activities such as municipal finance reforms and organizing youth festivals. Praja provides training sessions and facilitates peer learning to ensure effective engagement with city administration and legislators. The programme has led to tangible improvements in public services and urban governance reforms, demonstrating its impact on local communities. Prajatantra 2023 District New Delhi Mumbai State Delhi Maharashtra District New Delhi Mumbai States Delhi Maharashtra Praja Foundation announced the opening of registrations for Prajatantra 2023, India's premier youth festival promoting democracy. In collaboration with the Urban Youth Unit of the National Institute of Urban Affairs (NIUA), and with support from UN-Habitat and Friedrich Nauman Foundation South Asia, Prajatantra 2023 highlights the economic significance of cities under the theme 'Inclusive and Participatory Urban Economies'.
